stops.name: Davagh Forest
stops.detail:
Davagh Forest’s short circular walk begins from the upper car park and follows the black waymarker arrows alongside Davagh Water.

The true definition of a hidden gem, Davagh Forest lies approximately 6 miles north west of Cookstown in an untouched rural landscape of rolling hills and sweeping forests. It includes a unique network of walking and mountain biking trails that cater for all abilities.

Long-term trail closures remain in place at Beleevna, Wolf’s Hill and Big Wig Jig. These trails will remain closed until further notice to ensure the safety of all visitors.

Davagh Forest remains a working forest and forestry operations will continue across the site following harvesting. Haulage lorries and other forestry vehicles will remain in operation until all the harvested timber has been removed from the forest.

All walking and mountain biking trails are now open (with the exception of Beleevna, Wolf’s Hill and Big Wig Jig)  however, visitors should remain aware that forestry vehicles may still be operating on forest roads and in areas close to the trails, particularly around the trailhead.

Visitors are advised to exercise caution at all times, remain alert to moving vehicles and machinery and follow all safety signage and instructions from forestry service.

This pleasant riverside path meanders through lush green, almost fluorescent, woodland before crossing over Davagh Water and gradually ascending to meet the main forest road. The return leg of this walk uses the wide, surfaced forest road which leads down to meet the car park and back to the start of the trail.
